title: UAAP: UST stays unbeaten, rolls past La Salle for ninth straight win
summary: Defending champion University of Santo Tomas overwhelmed De La Salle University, 97-74, to remain unbeaten in UAAP Season 89 women’s basketball on Wednesday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
